title: Talk - Eben Moglen - Free and Open Software: Paradigm for a New Intellectual Commons
summary: Eben Moglen of the Software Freedom Conservancy speaks at the 2009 Law of the Commons Conference about free and open software as a model for a new intellectual commons. The talk covers the legal and social case for sharing knowledge.
why: Recommended as a worthwhile, full-length statement of the free software philosophy, especially around the zero marginal cost of knowledge.

quote.text: I promise every second is worth watching.
